options: Perdoor Anantapadmanabha Temple in Udupi district of Karnataka
Chennakesava Temple in Belur district of Karnataka

questions.question: Which Union Territory of India has separate administrative regions located on both the western and eastern coasts?
options: Puducherry with its units at Puducherry, Karaikal, Mahe, and Yanam
Lakshadweep with its coral islands dispersed in the Arabian Sea
Dadra and Nagar Haveli, and Daman and Diu situated near Gujarat coast
Andaman and Nicobar Islands positioned south of the Bay of Bengal
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Puducherry with its units at Puducherry, Karaikal, Mahe, and Yanam) है।

questions.question: The immediate factor that prompted the launch of the Home Rule League Movement in India in 1916 was:
options: India’s participation in World War I and influence of the Irish Home Rule League
the introduction of separate electorates under the Government of India Act of 1909
the failure of the Swadeshi and Boycott movements to sustain national mobilisation
the growing pressure of Indian revolutionaries operating from foreign territories
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (India’s participation in World War I and influence of the Irish Home Rule League) है।
